basis: Inherited dystonia with tremor and myoclonus; pursuit abnormalities and nystagmus reflect neurologic dysfunction rather than intrinsic eye damage.
Defined by muscular dystrophy and brain/eye malformations; oral clefting in a tiny series (1/3) does not reliably establish common gastrointestinal involvement.
LACC1-associated inflammatory arthritis; reactive leukocytosis and thrombocytosis do not establish intrinsic blood disease; rash alone does not establish skin damage.
Ocular disorder causing unequal perceived image size or shape between the eyes.
Genetically associated immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease; no additional commonly damaged organ established.
Syndrome defined by corpus callosum agenesis, intellectual disability and osseous lesions.
Structural enlargement of the right atrial appendage; dyspnea does not establish intrinsic pulmonary disease.
Defining periodontal destruction, joint hypermobility/dislocations and skin fragility; bruising reflects connective tissue fragility rather than a blood disorder.
Facioskeletal-genital syndrome supports skeletal involvement; genital anomalies have no axis. Sparse description prevents reliable additional labels.
Cytotoxic immune defect with cytopenias; hepatic inflammation/dysfunction common (>50%); STXBP2 enteropathy affects roughly 30-40%. Hearing/lung singleton reports lack population support.
ARX developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; microphthalmia reported in only 1/1 does not establish ocular damage in >=30% across this disorder.
Familial cirrhosis establishes liver disease; unspecified antigenemia alone does not establish an infectious or immune mechanism.
Defined by pregnancy-associated hypertension without end-organ damage; no renal, hepatic or neurologic involvement established.
Tumor of immature myeloid blood cells; extramedullary sites vary, with no single additional organ established as commonly involved.
Inherited epidermal disorder causing blistering and annular hyperkeratotic scaling.
Zellweger peroxisomal disorder with defining brain and liver disease; ocular dysfunction common (>30%), with cataract reported in 1/1; skeletal changes omitted by cap.
Auditory disorder defined by sound-induced otalgia; no separate neurologic damage established.
Melanocytic tumor arising in the meninges; melanocytic lineage does not establish skin involvement.
TTC8-associated retinal rod-cone degeneration; this retinal subtype does not establish multisystem ciliopathy.
Immune-mediated peripheral corneal ulceration with progressive corneal destruction.
Familial thoracic aortic aneurysm and dissection directly affect the aortic wall.
HSV-2 infection typically causes genital mucocutaneous lesions; neural latency does not establish neurologic damage, and CNS complications affect a minority.
Defining cardiac, skin/hair and neurodevelopmental disease; ocular abnormalities common, including ptosis 13/20 (65%); common chest skeletal anomalies omitted by cap.
Defining immunodeficiency, neutropenia/myelokathexis and persistent warts; pneumonia is a separate infection, while bronchiectasis occurs in only 5-29%.
Sensory/autonomic neuropathy, predominantly from sphingolipid biosynthesis defects; trophic skin damage and ulcers affect 30-79%; arthropathy and hearing loss only 5-29%.
